Legal Notice:pwl-privacy-notice.name: pwl-privacy-notice
Legal Notice:pwl-privacy-notice.title: Privacy Notice
Legal Notice:pwl-privacy-notice.description:
This Privacy Notice explains how Primstone Workforce Logistics LLC ("Primstone", "we", "us") collects and uses personal information through this website.

## Information we collect

**Information you give us.** When you submit a consultation request, we collect your name, business name, business email, phone number (optional), industry, the service you are interested in, your estimated need, desired start date, preferred contact method and the description you provide.

When you submit an expression of interest through the Careers page, we collect your name, email, phone number (optional), city and state, areas of interest, relevant experience, availability and, if you choose to attach it, your résumé.

**Information collected automatically.** Our website uses cookies that are necessary for it to work, such as keeping a session secure. Our servers also record basic technical information (IP address, browser type and the pages requested) to operate and protect the website.

## How we use your information

* To review and answer your consultation request.
* To review your expression of interest and contact you about suitable opportunities.
* To operate, maintain and protect our website.
* To comply with legal obligations.

## How we share your information

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with service providers that help us operate our website and business (for example, hosting and email providers), under obligations to protect it, or when required by law.

## How long we keep your information

We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes described above, or as required by law.

## Security

We use reasonable administrative and technical measures to protect personal information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure.

## Your choices

You may ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information you submitted through this website by writing to the email address below.

## Children

This website is not directed to children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

## Changes to this notice

We may update this notice. The date at the top shows when it was last updated.

## Contact us

Primstone Workforce Logistics LLC
100 Hartsfield Centre Parkway, Suite 500
Atlanta, GA 30354
[mercedes@pwl.services](mailto\:mercedes@pwl.services)

Service:pwl-temporary-staffing.name: pwl-temporary-staffing
Service:pwl-temporary-staffing.title: Temporary Staffing
Service:pwl-temporary-staffing.summary: Workforce support for agreed temporary assignments, subject to availability, role requirements, and applicable requirements.
Service:pwl-temporary-staffing.description:
Primstone provides workforce support for temporary assignments agreed with each client. Roles, schedules, and responsibilities are defined before the engagement begins, and staffing is subject to availability, role requirements, and applicable requirements.

Each engagement is defined by the agreed scope, staffing needs, operating environment, and applicable requirements. Every engagement includes a designated client point of contact during agreed operating hours, included in the agreed service rate. On-site supervision is optional and, if selected, is defined in the service agreement.
